Tesla is expanding its vehicle software and offering a new model for purchase. 

* Tesla has rolled out Full Self-Driving (FSD) v15 with photorealistic AI rendering, with a wide release planned for December [1].
* The company is inviting select customers to order the driverless Cybercab for $29,990, though it requires a $299 monthly Autonomy Subscription and is limited to Texas and Florida [2].
